title.rendered: The prestigious Inc. 5000 has recognized Franco Muñoz Law Firm as one of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States, solidifying their well-deserved spot on this coveted list.

content.rendered:
Franco Muñoz Law Firm, a distinguished Latinx-owned practice specializing in workers’ compensation legal services, is delighted to announce its inclusion in the prestigious 2023 Inc. 5000 roster of rapidly expanding companies in the United States. Notably, the firm holds the fourth position for growth among law firms in California, highlighting its unwavering dedication to providing exceptional legal solutions and added value to its clients.

Over the course of an exceptional three-year journey, Franco Muñoz has achieved an impressive 154% surge in revenue, showcasing the firm’s innovation and strategic prowess. This remarkable achievement reinforces the firm’s position as a pioneering force within the legal industry, committed to excellence, innovation, and advancement in the field of workers’ compensation law.

René Muñoz, one of the co-founders of Franco Muñoz, expressed his thoughts, stating, “Inclusion among the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. by Inc. 5000 is a significant milestone that underscores our pioneering role in the legal arena. Our ability to consistently deliver outstanding results for our clients is a testament to our exceptional team of attorneys and staff, whose dedication and expertise propel our mission.”

Co-founder Steve Franco added enthusiastically, “Earning a place on Inc. magazine’s list of fastest-growing companies in America is a testament to our team’s commitment to advocating for our clients. We are honored to stand alongside exceptional companies that share our dedication.”

Reflecting on their journey, Steve Franco shared, “As co-founders with immigrant working-class backgrounds, René and I possess a deep understanding of the challenges our clients face. Our vision was to establish a law firm that not only excels in the legal field but also remains deeply rooted in the communities we serve. Our upbringing profoundly influences our approach as workers’ compensation lawyers, and this recognition validates that our mission resonates with our clients and the industry.”

The Inc. 5000 class of 2023 not only recognizes companies with impressive revenue growth, with a combined 2022 revenue of $358 billion, but also showcases their ability to thrive amid challenges such as inflationary pressures, rising capital costs, and formidable hiring obstacles. These companies have collectively created over 1.18 million jobs, underscoring their significant impact on national employment and their excellence within the U.S. business landscape.

About Franco Muñoz Law Firm
Franco Muñoz Law Firm is a leading practice specializing in workers’ compensation law, offering comprehensive services to employees injured at work across Northern California. Founded in 2018 by first-generation Salvadoran-Americans Steve Franco and René Muñoz, the firm draws inspiration from their immigrant backgrounds to create a law firm deeply committed to its community. Their unique perspective equips them to understand their clients’ challenges intimately. Their vision was to establish a law firm that excels in the legal field while remaining deeply intertwined with the communities they serve. This dedication, along with their outstanding team of attorneys and staff, drives their mission forward.

Franco Muñoz’s accomplished legal team boasts an impressive track record, securing over $100 million in verdicts and settlements for its clients, including numerous seven-figure settlements and 100% permanent disability awards.

For more information about Franco Muñoz, please visit https://francomunos.com.

More about Inc. and the Inc. 5000

Methodology
Companies on the 2023 Inc. 5000 list are ranked based on their percentage revenue growth from 2019 to 2022. To qualify, companies must have been founded and generating revenue by March 31, 2019. They must also be U.S.-based, privately held, for-profit, and independent entities, not subsidiaries or divisions of other companies, as of December 31, 2022. (Since then, some on the list may have gone public or been acquired.) The minimum revenue required for 2019 is $100,000, and the minimum for 2022 is $2 million. Inc. reserves the right to decline applicants for subjective reasons. Growth rates used to determine rankings are calculated to four decimal places. For complete results of the Inc. 5000, please visit www.inc.com/inc5000.

About Inc.
Inc. Business Media is the leading multimedia brand for entrepreneurs. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of our community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are shaping our future. Inc.’s award-winning work reaches more than 50 million people across a variety of channels. Its proprietary Inc. 5000 list, produced every year since 1982, analyzes company data to rank the fastest-growing privately held businesses in the United States. For more information, please visit www.inc.com.
